title: activeCallId on Chat and SceneRegion has no consistency invariant
description: Both Chat.activeCallId and SceneRegion.activeCallId point to a VTCCall, but no spec text defines the invariant that they should match when a region is bound to a chat. They can diverge (chat has one active call, bound region has a different call or none), creating ambiguous UI state for 'join call' banners. Need a normative statement about the relationship: SHOULD match when chatId is set, or document when divergence is expected.
